agent_vs_you: Given the catalogue, the agent's diagnosis was correct: face-swap-video 'CANNOT: one face among several: it changes every face', and the executor really does hard-code face_swap_mode 'all-faces'. Its dialog was wrong. The expected behaviour was never to ask, yet it asked three near-identical questions. Twice the user answered 'your call', and it still asked again before ending with nothing made. After the first 'your call' it should have stopped asking and either delivered or stated the limit once. My plan differs because the capability exists one layer down. Magic Hour's /v1/face-swap has an 'individual-faces' mode with up to 5 face_mappings, and /v1/face-detection is free. The right plan is ONE mapped swap: the man in the light-blue shirt gets portrait-man.jpg, the blonde woman gets portrait-woman.jpg, and everyone else is left alone. The agent could not plan this because neither mode is wired or offered. The clip complicates things further: it has three main faces (two men and a woman), so 'the man' is ambiguous. I would map the man in the exchange with the woman (light-blue shirt, foreground) and leave the bearded man in navy unchanged.

steps.why: Only an individual-faces swap maps two portraits to two different people without collapsing them into one identity. The source clip's framing, timing and audio pass through untouched. About 300 credits for 10 s, which the free tier allows.

fix: New wiring, not a new model. (1) Wire POST /v1/face-detection (free) and face_swap_mode 'individual-faces' for face-swap-video and face-swap-photo. The tool takes the clip plus up to 5 portraits and extra 'map: <who in the clip> -> <portrait>'. The harness runs face detection, picks each detected face with a vision call against the planner's description ('man in light-blue shirt, left'), and sends face_mappings. (2) Catalogue line: 'WELL: several faces, each onto its own person (map them in extra); unmapped faces stay as they are'. (3) Dialog rule: once the user answers 'your call', the agent never re-asks the same question; it either plans or states the limit once and stops. (4) Spec: talk-two.mp4 has three main faces, not two, so the must-haves should name 'the man in the light-blue shirt', or the fixture should be regenerated with two people.
evidence: No output was made: three questions, and the judge recorded 'something was made = []' and 'asks nothing' failed. talk-two.mp4 is 858x480, 24 fps, 10.1 s, with audio. Frames at 2 s and 7 s and a 5-frame strip show THREE main people throughout: a man in a light-blue shirt (left, foreground, speaking to the woman), a bearded man in a navy shirt (centre, behind), and a blonde woman (right), who turns away around 4 s. There are also background extras. portrait-man.jpg is a grey-haired man in his fifties and portrait-woman.jpg a dark curly-haired young woman, so even a correct swap keeps the original hair. execute.js sends face_swap_mode 'all-faces' for both swap endpoints. magic-hour-api-sheet.md §5.1/5.3 documents 'individual-faces' with face_mappings ≤5 and a free face-detection endpoint.
